archetypes.name: Armoured Spearhead
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Predators can be taken as Troops.
- Legion Sicaran Battle Tanks can be taken as Elites.
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Land Raider Carrier instead if it has ten models or fewer.

archetypes.name: Brethren of Iron
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- The army has access to all Robot units from the Horus Heresy Mechanicum supplement.
- Castellax Battle-automata Maniple units may be taken as Troops.
- Only Robot units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.

archetypes.name: Death from Above
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Assault Squad units may be taken as Troops.
- Only Legion Assault Squad units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- At least half of all Legion Assault Squad models must start the game in reserves, even if the mission does not allow reserves.

archetypes.name: Drop Pod Assault (HH)
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- All units must start the game as passengers inside a Legion Drop Pod.
- Half of all Legion Drop Pods in the army (round up) arrive automatically in the first battle round as reinforcements. The other half arrive automatically in the second battle round.

archetypes.name: Legion Specialists
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- The army may take 1-3 HQ and 0-4 Elite units in the first AOP.
- Techmarines and Apothecaries cannot be promoted to a Forge Lord or a Primus Medicae.

archetypes.name: Outrider Phalanx
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Outrider Squadron and Legion Sky-hunter Squadron units may be taken as Troops.
- Outflanking units may be deployed on turn 1.
- All units with less than 12" Movement must start the game as passengers inside a transport.
- Units that have no transport option and less than 12" Movement cannot be taken at all.

archetypes.name: Pride of the Legion
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Veteran Squad, Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad, Legion Tartaros Terminator Squad units may be taken as Troops.
- Any unit composed entirely of models with either Cataphractii Terminator armor, Tartaros Terminator armor or any other pattern of Terminator armor and that is normally selected as an Elites choice may be taken as Troops.
- Only Veteran and Terminator units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- Only a single Heavy Support choice and a single Fast Attack choice may be taken in this army.

archetypes.name: Recon Demi-Company
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Scout Squads and Seeker Squads can be taken as Troops.

archetypes.name: Underworld Assault
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- All units must start the game as passengers inside a Legion Termite.
- Half of all Legion Termites in the army (round up) arrive automatically in the first battle round as reinforcements. The other half arrive automatically in the second battle round.

archetypes.name: Alpha Legion
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Hydra".
- Any model in a Legion Tartaros Terminator Squad, Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad, Legion Veteran Squad or Seeker Squad may give its Bolters the "Poison(4+)" ability for +5 points each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Alpha Legion Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Mutable Tactics" or "Lies and Obfuscation". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Iron Warriors
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Lord of Iron".
- Any model may exchange their Power mauls for Graviton maces for +1 point each and Thunder hammers for Graviton crushers for +1 point each.
- Any model may exchange their Bolt pistols for Shrapnel bolt pistols for +5 points each, Bolters for Shrapnel bolters for +7 points each and Heavy bolters for Shrapnel heavy bolters for +3 points each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Iron Warriors Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "To The Bitter End" or "Siege Experts". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Emperor's Children
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Phoenician".
- Kakophoni Squads can be taken as Troops.
- Only Kakophoni Squads count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Emperor's Children Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Flawless Execution" or "Exemplars of War". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Night Lords
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Night Haunter".
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Night Lords Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Horrors of the Night" or "Bloody Murder". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: World Eaters
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Lord of Red Sands".
- Any model may exchange their Astartes chainswords for Chainaxes for +1 point each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the World Eaters Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "The Butcher's Nails" or "Bloodlust". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Word Bearers
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Archtraitor".
- Any model may exchange their Plasma pistols for Warpfire pistols for +1 point each and Plasma blasters for Warpfire blasters for +1 point each.
- Gal Vorbak can also be taken as Troops.
- Only Gal Vorbak count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Word Bearers Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "True Believers" or "Cut Them Down". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Death Guard
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Death Lord".
- Any model may exchange their Hand flamers for Alchem pistols for +1 point each, Flamers for Alchem flamers for +3 points each and Combi-flamers for Alchem combi-flamers for +1 point each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Death Guard Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Remorseless and Intractable" or "Sons of Barbarus". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Sons of Horus
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Warmaster".
- Any model in a Legion Tartaros Terminator Squad, Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad, Legion Veteran Squad or Seeker Squad may give its Bolters and Combi-bolters the "Rending(6+)" ability for +5 points each.
- Any model may give its Power weapons the "Rending(5+)" ability for +2 points each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Sons of Horus Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Merciless Fighters" or "Death Dealers". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Thousand Sons
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Crimson King".
- Any Legion Veteran Squad may take the "Khenetai" upgrade: all its models replace their melee weapons with a Pair of force swords for +24 points per model, and its squad leader may choose the "Mindsong of Blades" power (Bladesinging discipline) as the power of its Thousand Sons Legion benefit.
- Any Seeker Squad may take the "Ammitara" upgrade at no extra cost: its squad leader may choose the "Mind Killer" power (Clairvoyance discipline) as the power of its Thousand Sons Legion benefit.
- The squad leader of a Legion Tactical Squad may choose the "Psy-Synchronicity" power (Numerology discipline) as the power of its Thousand Sons Legion benefit.
- Any model may exchange their Bolt pistols for Asphyx bolt pistols for +1 point each and Bolters for Asphyx bolters for +1 point each.
- Castellax-Achea Automata can be taken as Troops.
- Only Castellax-Achea Automata count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Thousand Sons Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Signs and Portents" or "Sorcerous Translocation". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Blackshields
archetypes.desc:
- The army has two Legacies (any two Legions of this book), both chosen in Army Customisation, and each unit and character chooses which of the two it belongs to.
- A unit has everything of the Legacy it belongs to: its Legion benefits, its Armory, the special units, the Troops and the options of that Legion.
- The two Legacies must be of Legions that are not marked red against each other in the Legion alliances tab.
- Warriors who cast off their Legion's insignia and honours: a unit is of one Legion or of the other, never of a third.
- The army has access to a third Trait, to choose from the list: three Legion Traits instead of two.

legacies.name: Legacy of the Phoenician
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Emperor's Children Armory.
- The army has the mark of the Emperor's Children Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lord of Iron
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Iron Warriors Armory.
- The army has the mark of the Iron Warriors Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Night Haunter
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Night Lords Armory.
- The army has the mark of the Night Lords Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lord of Red Sands
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the World Eaters Armory.
- The army has the mark of the World Eaters Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Death Lord
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Death Guard Armory and the Witchblood psychic discipline.
- The army has the mark of the Death Guard Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Crimson King
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Thousand Sons Armory and the Prosperine Arcana psychic discipline.
- The army has the mark of the Thousand Sons Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Warmaster
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Sons of Horus Armory.
- The army has the mark of the Sons of Horus Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Archtraitor
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Word Bearers Armory and the Diabolism psychic discipline.
- The army has the mark of the Word Bearers Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Hydra
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Alpha Legion Armory.
- The army has the mark of the Alpha Legion Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Sundered
legacies.desc: The army has access to the Blackshields Armory and the Malignant psychic discipline.

traits.name: Flawless Execution
traits.desc: If the unit uses a Charge order, it gains +1 Initiative and may re-roll melee to hit rolls of 1 until the end of the current battle round. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: To The Bitter End
traits.desc: When the unit would flee, it may choose to become pinned instead.

traits.name: Siege Experts
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Sunder(1)" ability for all ranged attacks.

traits.name: Horrors of the Night
traits.desc: The unit gains +1 to hit and +1 to wound in melee against units with at least one Battleshock token or if the enemy unit is outnumbered. When determining if a unit is outnumbered, models with the "Massive(X) special rule count as a number of models equal to 1 + the value included as part of that special rule. Models with the Vehicle Unit Type count as a number of models equal to 3 x their hull points.

traits.name: Bloody Murder
traits.desc: All melee attacks of the unit gain the "Gruesome" ability. The unit itself gains the "Terrifying(-1)" ability.

traits.name: The Butcher's Nails
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Berserk(5+)" ability. At the end of each activation, roll a D6 for each unit with this rule that is not engaged in close combat. For each 1, remove one model from the unit. Only for creature units.

traits.name: Bloodlust
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Blind Rage" ability.

traits.name: Remorseless and Intractable
traits.desc: At the beginning of its activation, the unit may choose to gain the "Unyielding" ability until its next activation.

traits.name: Sons of Barbarus
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Move through cover" ability.

traits.name: Signs and Portents
traits.desc: If the unit or an attached Character suffer Perils of the Warp, the unit gains one Battleshock token.

traits.name: Sorcerous Translocation
traits.desc: Up to six Infantry units (not characters) gain the "Deep strike" ability; the turn such a unit arrives by Deep strike it also has the "Terrifying(-1)" ability.

traits.name: Merciless Fighters
traits.desc: The unit gains +1 attack in melee against units with at least one Battleshock token or if the enemy unit is outnumbered. When determining if a unit is outnumbered, models with the "Massive(X) special rule count as a number of models equal to 1 + the value included as part of that special rule. Models with the Vehicle Unit Type count as a number of models equal to 3 x their hull points. Additionally, Vehicles gain an additional +3 automatic hits when performing a Tank Shock.

traits.name: Death Dealers
traits.desc: If the unit is making a ranged attack against targets within 12", it gains +1 to ranged to wound rolls.

traits.name: True Believers
traits.desc: The unit may re-roll failed Leadership tests.

traits.name: Cut Them Down
traits.desc: The unit gains +1d3 to its combat resolution in melee (not cumulative between multiple units), and may roll 2d6 to pursue fleeing units.

traits.name: Mutable Tactics
traits.desc: Each creature unit may select one Veteran ability, or gain an additional one if it already has access to them.

traits.name: Lies and Obfuscation
traits.desc: The unit gains the benefit of light cover until its first activation.

Emperor's Children.note: Mark of Emperor's Children (EC): The model gains +1 Weapon skill. A character model or Monstrous Creature gains additionally +2" Movement. Vehicles lower the Ld or close combat result of hostile models by -1 within a 18" range and by -2 within 9". Costs +3 points per model, +6 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

Iron Warriors.note: Mark of Iron Warriors (IW): The model gains +1 Ballistic skill. A character model or Monstrous Creature gains additionally +1 Strength. Vehicles gain the "Sunder(1)" ability for all ranged attacks. Costs +3 points per model, +6 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

Night Lords.note: Mark of Night Lords (NL): The model gains +1 Initiative. A character model or Monstrous Creature gains additionally +1 Attack. Vehicles gain the "Terrifying(-1)" ability. Costs +3 points per model, +6 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

World Eaters.note: Mark of World Eaters (WE): The model gains +1 Attack. A character model or Monstrous Creature gains additionally +1 Strength. Vehicles cause double hits when performing a Tank Shock. Costs +3 points per model, +6 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

Death Guard.note: Mark of Death Guard (DG): The model gains +1 Toughness. A character model or Monstrous Creature gains additionally +1 Wound. Vehicles roll 2D6 during each Reinforcement phase. On a roll of 7+ they may either remove a "Crew Shaken" result, or one "Engine Damage" or one "Weapon Damage" or restore one lost HP. Costs +2 points per model, +19 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

Thousand Sons.note: Mark of Thousand Sons (TS): The model gains the "Warded" ability. A character model, a squad leader or a Monstrous Creature becomes a psyker and knows 1 power from any discipline. If the model is already a psyker, instead it can manifest and deny an additional power per battle round. Vehicles get a Warpflamer weapon (Range: 9", Type: Assault 4, S: 4, AP: -1, Dmg: 1, Auto Hit, Sunder(1)). Costs +5 points per model, +13 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

Sons of Horus.note: Mark of Sons of Horus (SoH): The model gains +1 Strength. A character model or Monstrous Creature gains additionally +1 Attack. Vehicles ignore the first "Weapon Destroyed" result each battle round. Costs +3 points per model, +6 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

Word Bearers.note: Mark of Word Bearers (WB): The model gains +1 Leadership. A character model or Monstrous Creature becomes a psyker and knows 1 power from any discipline. If the model is already a psyker, instead it can manifest and deny an additional power per battle round. Vehicles cause a Battleshock token on each Infantry unit they Tank Shock. Costs +3 points per model, +7 per character model, +10 per vehicle.

Alpha Legion.note: Mark of Alpha Legion (AL): The model gains the "Infiltrator" ability if it is Infantry, otherwise +1 Initiative. A character model or Monstrous Creature gains additionally +1 Weapon skill. Vehicles gain the benefit of light cover until their first activation. Costs +1 points per model, +4 per character model, +10 per vehicle.
